response.sql: WITH exams AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), deviations AS (SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, acl_igm - (SELECT AVG(acl_igm) FROM exams) AS deviation FROM exams), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.average_deviation AS excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.average_deviation ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
